resources.string: Active foreground service for instant screen projection
Tap Quick Settings tile anytime to capture to Google Lens
Please enable QuickLens Accessibility Service first
Google Lens is not installed on this device
QuickLens uses this service to take instant screenshots for Google Lens visual search without repeated permission dialogs.
Directly trigger search when tapping the QuickLens icon on your home screen
Hold the bottom navigation pill to trigger Circle to Search natively
Tip: Long-press the app icon on your home screen and select \'Settings\' to open this screen at any time.
